en.t: It is the season for eating soft-shelled turtle now.

units.source_text: 我在北野大市已经订好坐席，请你光临。

en.t: I have already reserved seats at the Kitano market, so please come.

units.source_text: 以我的身份去请令尊令堂，未免太冒失了，所以请你……

en.t: For someone in my position to invite your parents would be far too forward, so I am inviting you...

units.source_text: 我还带上我家的‘童男’去。”

en.t: I will also bring along our family's 'boy attendant.'
